_comment: Garmin Custom Maps capability per model. Tile caps are firmware render-cache limits; storage doesn't help. Default cap claims are sourced in docs/watch_matrix.md. 'disputed' = web record says 100 but project's empirical build at ~489 tiles renders fine on the maintainer's Epix 2.
